posts.t: Kraken’s Jared McCann to miss game against Wild with injury

Wild have allowed six goals in two games. 

All six* on the PK.

*technically five, but a power play had just expired on a goal in Edmonton.

Aggressive push from the Wild the last two minutes with the extra attacker but couldn't find the equalizer. 

Wild 0-1-1 so far on the trip.

Wild drop a 2-1 decision to Calgary. 

Special teams again: Wild 0/4 PP, Flames 2/4 PP. 

McCarron with the Wild goal.

Cooley was cool in net for the Flames.
Sturm with an assist for his point of the season, too.
McCarron finally breaks through. His first of the season, Wild on the board in Calgary.
Yurov on the top PP unit with Shabanov out tonight.
Wild have taken three minors so far in the first period in Calgary. One PPG allowed already tonight.

Wild continue the road trip in Calgary tonight. 

#ICYMI, a road-trip preview for Wild dot com: Wild Out West

Wild coming into tonight had allowed 3 PPGs in nine games. 

Wild's PK, which has been solid to start the season, allowed 3 PPGs to Edmonton tonight.

Oilers win it 4-3 in OT. 

Basically 4 PPGs tonight for Edmonton. Wild come back from two down in the third. Hartman gets his first of the year. 

Wild are 0-2 in OT games this season.

11 assists in 10 games for Quinn Hughes. 

11 goals in 10 games for Kirill Kaprizov.

Hartman is on the board. 

Big goal there, to tie it.

Kaprizov with a beauty for No. 11 this season. Great feed from Boldy. 

Makes it a one-goal game.
